_help: Home page sections (shelves) and cards. Each section has a title, an icon (an emoji), a color (yellow, mint, coral or violet) and a short blurb. Each card shows only its cover and name. Cover: put a picture in images/covers/ named after the card id with underscores, like crypto_in_5.png; until then a drawn placeholder shows, using color (yellow, blue, coral, mint, violet, orange, pink or teal), pattern (dots, stripes, grid, zigzag, waves, checks, plus, rings or triangles; give every card a different colour and pattern pair), edge (tape, notch, corner, stamp, pin or round: a small detail that makes each card feel different) and object (cube, key, skull, coins, magnifier, lock, briefcase, badge, trophy, moneybag, pie, moon, button, pizza, rod or rocket). blurb is read out to screen reader users. Toy pages also use topic, font (luckiest, bungee, bangers or chewy) and accent. If you rename a toy, also change its name in its own index.html and in quizzes/index.json. status: live (clickable) or soon (shows a Soon sticker), set on each card. Each live card's id must match its toy file in data/toys/ and its quiz in quizzes/, except cards with kind game, like Spot the Scam, which are stand-alone games without a certificate.
